title: 除夕

series.next: The second visitor is already in the lift, and knows exactly how many calls from home you've ignored.

setting: An office tower, 除夕, 8 pm. Everyone has gone home but you, and your assistant 小葛.

xiaoge.name: 小葛
xiaoge.en: your assistant: kind, and wants to go home

xiaodeng.name: 小灯笼
xiaodeng.en: a child with a red lantern, on your desk

laoma.name: 老妈
laoma.en: your mother, the year you were eight

yeye.name: 爷爷
yeye.en: your grandfather, the year you were eight

steps.narr: 除夕, 8 pm. Across the river, the first fireworks. One floor of an office tower, lights on.
Your phone: three missed calls from home. You turn it face down. It's your third New Year at the office.

steps.en: Um... could I leave a bit early?

steps.zh: 我妈包了饺子，等我回家。
steps.en: My mum's made dumplings. She's waiting for me.

say.en: Say no: the report isn't finished.
say.tip: 还没写完 = not finished writing yet: 没 + verb + 完.

ok.narr: She sits back down, very quietly. Her phone buzzes. She doesn't look at it.

answers: 不行，明天要交的报告还没写完。
4.gloss: No. The report due tomorrow isn't finished.

steps.narr: Across the river, a big red firework. It lights up 小葛's lock screen: a plate of dumplings, and a woman waving flour-white hands.

say.tip: 算了 = never mind, forget it: the gentle change of mind.

ok.zh: 您也早点回家！新年快乐！
ok.en: You go home early too! Happy New Year!

answers: 算了，你走吧，替我给阿姨拜个年。
4.gloss: Never mind, go on. Wish your mum a happy New Year from me.
4.tip: 拜年 bàinián = give New Year greetings. 替我 = on my behalf.

steps.narr: Alone. The fireworks get louder, then closer. At midnight, every light on the floor goes out.
Then one light: red, paper, on your desk. A lantern. Holding it, a child in a padded jacket, swinging her legs.

steps.en: On 除夕? All by yourself?

say.en: Ask her who she is, and how she got in.
say.gloss: Who are you? How did you get in?
say.tip: 怎么进来的？ = how did you get in? 是……的 is understood.

ok.en: I'm the first one come to see you.
There are two more, after me.
I'll take you to see a 除夕.

answers: 你是谁家的孩子？怎么进来的？
4.gloss: Whose child are you? How did you get in?

say.tip: 带 dài = take (someone along). 带我去 = take me there.

ok.narr: She takes your hand. Hers is warm, and smells of firecracker smoke.
The office melts away. The old flat. Your own 除夕, the year you were eight.

4.gloss: All right. Take me to see.

steps.narr: Everyone is there: 老妈 with flour on her hands, 爷爷 in the good chair, the New Year gala far too loud on the TV.

steps.zh: 饺子好了！谁吃到硬币，明年有福气！
steps.en: Dumplings are ready! Whoever finds the coin gets luck all next year!
Good! A lucky year for you!
That year, everyone was still here.

steps.zh: 你可以跟小时候的你说一句话。或者，就看看。
steps.en: You can say one thing to your younger self. Or just watch.

say.en: Speak to your eight-year-old self, or only watch.
say.gloss: Spend more time with your family.
say.tip: 陪 péi = be with, keep company. 多陪陪 = spend more time with.

ok.narr: Your eight-year-old self looks straight at you, as if they can hear.

then.narr: You watch. 爷爷 peels a tangerine and gives you half, the way he always did.

answers: 记住今天，以后要多陪陪家人。
4.gloss: Remember today. Spend more time with your family.

answers: 不了，我不打扰，我就看看。
alts.gloss: No. I won't intrude. I'll just watch.

steps.en: The lantern goes out. You're at your desk, and without quite deciding to, you've pressed call: home. 🏮

else.en: The lantern goes out. You're at your desk, holding a tangerine peel that wasn't there before. 🏮
